paragraphs: Hi, I'm Shakirul Hasan Khan, a software engineer with over four years of experience in full-stack development.
Currently working at Re:cruit, building an AI sidekick with React, NextJS, Python and LLMs. I specialize in ReactJS, NextJS, and TypeScript.
I create scalable, user-focused applications with a strong ability to deliver solutions meeting complex design and performance needs.
